data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2015. In 2014 there was a reserve release of GBP 2.6m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve strengthening generated by the Professional Liability account

prior_year_events.event_name: Cargo account losses (marine cargo business written in 2014)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Cargo account suffered losses arising from business written in 2014 contributing to reserve strengthening

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (31 Dec 2014) were GBP 102.816m. The syndicate recorded an aggregate gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 8.49m (about 8.3% of opening reserves) in 2015, driven principally by adverse development in Professional Liability and cargo (marine) accounts; net of reinsurance the report states a GBP 4.4m strengthening. The movement was identified in the claims development table and is described in the technical provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2015.
In 2014 there was a reserve release of GBP 2.6m.
The reserve strengthening in 2015 was generated by the Professional Liability and Cargo accounts.
The marine account has suffered from a number of larger losses and in particular the cargo account has suffered from losses arising from business written in 2014.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not explicitly stated as a single gross figure; gross PYD was computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) on page 30 as +GBP 8.492m. The report also states a net strengthening of GBP 4.4m (net of reinsurance). Some lines in the segmental analysis are faint in the image (small/negative/misaligned rows) and a few very small items (e.g. 'Motor (Other Classes)') may be subject to OCR/read errors. All monetary values in the triangle and balance sheet are presented in GBP '000; triangle extraction used those values and converted to millions.
